description: One DISCLOSED economic-dependency edge between two companies (or a company and a customer/supplier/geography it named in its own filing). Non-adjudicating (G2): an observation of what the filer itself disclosed (e.g. a customer-concentration note, a segment, a major-supplier disclosure) — never an inferred or scored relationship, never a verdict. The supply-chain / world-economy face shared with kabuto (兜).

to.description: Counterparty org.corp.* id when the filer named it; omitted when the disclosure is unnamed (e.g. 'one customer >10% of revenue').

relation.description: The kind of dependency the FILER disclosed.

share.description: Disclosed share as a decimal string when the filer quantified it (e.g. concentration %); omitted otherwise.

basisFact.description: rkey/uri of the com.etzhayyim.kanjo.disclosure fact this edge is grounded in.

docCid.description: IPFS CID of the source filing.
